profile.name: Hannah
profile.title: Lead Software Engineer
bio: I'm a creative, motivated software engineer who's spent the last few years building web and mobile apps across industrial, banking, sustainability and healthcare — most recently leading a team building a global EV charging app at IBM.

My day-to-day stack is React / React Native / TypeScript on the front, Node + GraphQL on the back, and AWS underneath. I care a lot about how teams work together — coding standards, agile ways of working, and lifting up the people around me.
Before software, I trained as a broadcast engineer through an apprenticeship at the BBC and a first-class BEng — keeping 16+ radio stations on the air taught me how to ship under pressure.
